integrity: Complete exact integer group census and witness verifier are bundled; independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The spectrum is for arbitrary smooth degree-two del Pezzo surfaces in odd characteristic, and existence of an extremal surface is proved for odd q at least 9 through a published realization theorem; explicit extremal equations are not supplied.
The small odd fields q=3,5,7 are not classified for attainment of the bound, although the upper bound holds.
Weyl element frequencies are not surface-isomorphism frequencies over any given finite field; geometric rationality is not the invariant.
title: A sharp degree-eighteen descent bound for plane contractions of degree-two del Pezzo surfaces
